snippet.title: Corporate Fury: Capitalist Corruption Edition - New Port Features
snippet.description: A look at some of the new features (1-on-100 battle mode and the MAGA hat) in Corporate Fury: Capitalist Corruption Edition. This is a port of Corporate Fury from first-gen iOS devices to Windows. The game is free and available for download here: http://richwhitehouse.com/index.php?content=inc_projects.php&showproject=92
